claims.text: CMV encephalitis: ganciclovir and/or other antivirals
claims.quote: Cytomegalovirus encephalitis can be treated with ganciclovir and/or other antiviral medications.

claims.text: Empiric antibiotics often given until bacterial meningitis is excluded
claims.quote: empiric antibiotics are often given until bacterial meningitis is excluded

claims.text: Immunologic reaction (eg, acute disseminated encephalomyelitis): start tx immediately; glucocorticoids (prednisone or methylprednisolone) and plasma exchange or IVIG
claims.quote: If clinicians suspect that encephalitis is caused by an immunologic reaction (eg, acute disseminated encephalomyelitis [postinfectious encephalomyelitis]), treatment should be begun immediately; it may include glucocorticoids (prednisone or methylprednisolone) and plasma exchange or IV immune globulin.
